zh-CN: 库存数量与 GB 容量可打开记录统计，按月纵向翻阅完整历史或查看年度汇总。
活跃度默认显示截至当前周的最近 16 周，正常宽度占满区域，只有窄窗口才提供横向滚动。
白昼主题无封面随机漫步使用森林绿金渐变，空仓库立即显示同一背景；顶部导航保持居中且不与其他控件重叠。
en-US: Inventory and GB totals open scrollable monthly history or yearly summaries.
Activity shows the latest 16 weeks by default, fills normal-width containers, and scrolls horizontally only in narrow windows.
Daylight no-cover Random Walk cards use the Forest green-and-gold gradient, including an immediate empty-library background; top navigation stays centered without overlapping other controls.
